orgsTab.deleteConfirmPrompt: Deleting "{{id}}" destroys every source, domain, table and role in it, for everyone in it. This cannot be undone. Type {{id}} to confirm.
orgsTab.invitesFilterPlaceholder: Filter by org, token, or creator…
orgsTab.invitesIntro: An invite link is how someone gets an account and a role in an organization. Creating an organization here already makes you its administrator, so the usual reason to send a link from this tab is to hand an organization over: invite the person who will run it as org_admin, then step back out. Registration opens at the link, and the role below is granted the moment they sign up.
orgsTab.inviteRoleDescription: org_admin hands the organization to the invitee; other roles admit them as a regular member.
orgsTab.orgIdDesc: 2-40 characters, lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter. It becomes the schema name and the subdomain, and cannot be changed later.
